(I)--married कृपी, and was the father of अश्वत्थाम.
1: भा.

. २७; IX. २१. ३६. Vi. IV. १९. ६८; V. ३५. 5, २७.
Taught Dhanurveda to the पाण्डवस् but served Duryodhana's army, succeeding भीष्म as com- mander, and after a five days' battle was killed by धृष्टद्- yumna;
2: भा. I. १५. १५-16; X. ७८ [(९५ (V) १६], २९-36.
met by कृतवर्मन्, कृष्ण and राम.
3: Ib. X. ५२. [५६ (V) 4], १२; ५७. 2.
Informed by Uddhava of राम's visit to हस्तिनापुर; invited for the [page२-144+ २५] राजसुय of युधिष्ठिर.
4: Ib. X. ६८. १७ and २८; ७४. १०.
Went to स्यमन्तपञ्चक for solar eclipse and met there कृष्ण and the वृष्णिस्.

(III)--a Vasu born as Nanda; his wife was अभिमती, and sons were हर्ष, शोक, Bhaya and others. भा.
(IV)--Mt. a hill of शाल्मलिद्वीप (कुशद्वीप- म्। प्।) noted for great medicinal plants, विशल्यकरणी and मृतसन्जीविनि, capable of bringing back the dead to life. Br. II. १९. ३८-39; वा. ४९. ३५; Vi.
(I)--(also द्रौणि) the future Veda व्यास in द्वापर yuga. Br. II. ३५. १२५; Vi.
(II)--a Sage of the 8th epoch of Manu. Vi.
